# telnyx_porting_order_phone_number_configuration_set (Action)

Sets the configuration of phone numbers in porting orders, such as the user bundle they use.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `phone_number_configurations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_configurations))

<a id="nestedatt--phone_number_configurations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_number_configurations`

Required:

- `porting_phone_number_id` (String) Identifies the porting phone number to be configured.
- `user_bundle_id` (String) Identifies the user bundle to be associated with the porting phone number.
